hero.testimonial: Parvaj combines deep embedded systems expertise with biomedical product development experience. He successfully delivered a complete NPWT system, integrating firmware, control algorithms, and hardware validation with a strong focus on reliability and clinical applicability.

about.description: Embedded Systems Engineer specializing in STM32, NXP(MIMXRT1166), Raspberry pi, and ESP32 platforms with expertise in real-time firmware, RTOS architecture, and biomedical device development. Experienced in delivering production-ready embedded systems including hardware integration, control algorithms, and safety-critical medical applications in collaboration with IIT Delhi and AIIMS Delhi.

skills.title: Full system designs with H/W and S/W

workExperience.company: Inochi care Pvt limited, New Delhi
workExperience.description: Designing and developing STM32-based NPWT biomedical systems with complete firmware architecture, closed-loop pressure control, sensor integration, and PWM-based pump regulation. Experienced in full hardware-software integration, custom LCD driver implementation over MIPI DSI, and system-level debugging to ensure reliable medical-grade performance.
